cases.title: Nemotron wrote the fix. The same task proved it.
cases.impact: The scanner reports zero violations, yet Enter opens a checkout dialog that keyboard focus never enters. A keyboard user cannot place the order.
cases.explanation: NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory read the failed journey and the source, then proposed this patch: Add focus management functions to openDialog (show dialog and focus field), closeDialog (hide dialog and focus trigger), and a keydown handler on the dialog to trap Tab/Shift+Tab cycling among the dialog's focusable elements (close button, field, action button) and handle Escape to close. Replace existing click handlers with these functions. Tabstitch applied it in a disposable copy and replayed the identical keyboard journey plus the pointer functional check.

failure.message: Expected state did not occur after action

provenance.kind: Synthetic application · live NVIDIA Nemotron proposal

cases.impact: The replacement button can now be activated with the keyboard. But its confirmation changes to “Wrong account”. Calling that a successful repair would hide a functional regression.
cases.explanation: The repair gate rejects the candidate because the original functional contract fails. Better keyboard behavior alone cannot authorize a broken application.

cases.title: The dialog closes. Focus is left behind.
cases.impact: After Escape hides an opacity-based dialog, focus is pulled back into invisible content. The page looks ready; the keyboard user has lost their place.
cases.explanation: This historical a11y-dialog change removes the focus listeners before restoring the opener. We reproduced the original failure and replayed the published human fix on the same task.
